customers.business_rule: Operational standard customer; name is not legal-source evidence.

workers.business_rule: Current rate supplies only the default for a new work log.

source_of_truth.runtime: Supabase after cutover; canonical files are historical migration/reconciliation input only

derived_fields.calculated_labor_amount: daily_rate_snapshot * raw_md only when labor_source=CALCULATED and entry_type=NORMAL_WORK
derived_fields.expected_profit: contract_supply_amount is null ? null : contract_supply_amount - actual_total_cost
derived_fields.cost_ratio: contract_supply_amount is null or zero ? null : actual_total_cost / contract_supply_amount
derived_fields.cost_budget_remaining: cost_budget_amount is null ? null : cost_budget_amount - actual_total_cost

invariants: site_code is unique; site name is not unique and protected multi-contract sites never merge.
S067 and S068 remain independent contract/profit units; shared Yeosu wording never causes automatic cross-assignment.
Assignment changes never overwrite immutable source evidence.
Active allocation amounts are positive and their sum never exceeds active transaction original_amount; FULL requires equality.
Moving an allocation changes site totals but not company expense total.
Moving a work log changes site totals but not company labor total.
Changing workers.current_daily_rate never changes an existing work log snapshot or labor amount.
HOLIDAY has countable_md=0 labor_amount=0 cost_scope=NONE; OTHER has countable_md=0 and historical paid labor may be OVERHEAD.
Blank or invalid dates do not enter calendar queries or create ghost/+N entries.
NULL and zero contract amounts produce null cost_ratio; no truthy/falsy numeric fallback.
UI Excel and PDF consume the same financial read model and do not recalculate profit independently.
Import replay does not delete existing rows and inserts zero duplicate source events.
Source history is voided or superseded instead of hard deleted.

transition_rules.rule: Use for future new work-log snapshot only.
Recompute labor_amount from the existing snapshot.
Require explicit keep/replace labor decision and reason; never auto-recompute.
Move labor scope; produce linked-expense suggestions; never force allocation movement.
Preserve original evidence through void/supersede semantics and revalidate allocations.
Permit only when no active superseding record conflicts and all authorization/invariants pass.

compatibility_strategy.transaction_decision: Retain transactions and enrich it; do not create card_transactions.
compatibility_strategy.manual_expense_decision: Represent manual/cash/account expenses in transactions with source_type=MANUAL.
compatibility_strategy.physical_site_decision: No physical_sites table now; nullable descriptive/group fields on sites are sufficient.
compatibility_strategy.labor_decision: Store labor_amount and daily_rate_snapshot on each work log.
compatibility_strategy.summary_decision: One security-invoker site_financial_summary_v2 database view is the reporting contract.
compatibility_strategy.legacy_read: Keep legacy columns/tables until parity gates pass.
compatibility_strategy.legacy_write: Stage dual-write with observability; never full-delete-and-reimport.
compatibility_strategy.canonical: Historical input only after operational cutover.
